-- ============================================================
-- 3D ONLINE BOOK
-- PostgreSQL ERD Schema
-- UUID strategy: UUID v7 generated by application layer
-- ORM: Drizzle
-- Backend: NestJS
-- Storage: Cloudflare R2
-- ============================================================


-- ============================================================
-- 1. USERS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash TEXT,
    avatar_url TEXT,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT users_status_check
        CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'BANNED'))
);


-- ============================================================
-- 2. USER PROFILES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE user_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    full_name VARCHAR(150),
    bio TEXT,
    birth_date DATE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT fk_user_profiles_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- 3. ROLES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE roles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);


-- ============================================================
-- 4. USER ROLES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE user_roles (
    user_id UUID NOT NULL,
    role_id UUID NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id),

    CONSTRAINT fk_user_roles_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_user_roles_role
        FOREIGN KEY (role_id)
        REFERENCES roles(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- 5. REFRESH TOKENS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE refresh_tokens (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL,
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    CONSTRAINT fk_refresh_tokens_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- 6. AUTHORS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE authors (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    bio TEXT,
    avatar_url TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);


-- ============================================================
-- 7. CATEGORIES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE categories (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    slug VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    image_url TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);


-- ============================================================
-- 8. BOOKS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE books (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    slug VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    cover_url TEXT,

    language VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vi',
    age_range VARCHAR(50),

    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',

    rating NUMERIC(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    total_views BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT books_status_check
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'DRAFT',
                'PUBLISHED',
                'ARCHIVED'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT books_rating_check
        CHECK (rating >= 0 AND rating <= 5),

    CONSTRAINT books_total_views_check
        CHECK (total_views >= 0)
);


-- ============================================================
-- 9. BOOK CATEGORIES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE book_categories (
    book_id UUID NOT NULL,
    category_id UUID NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (book_id, category_id),

    CONSTRAINT fk_book_categories_book
        FOREIGN KEY (book_id)
        REFERENCES books(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_book_categories_category
        FOREIGN KEY (category_id)
        REFERENCES categories(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- 10. BOOK AUTHORS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE book_authors (
    book_id UUID NOT NULL,
    author_id UUID NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (book_id, author_id),

    CONSTRAINT fk_book_authors_book
        FOREIGN KEY (book_id)
        REFERENCES books(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_book_authors_author
        FOREIGN KEY (author_id)
        REFERENCES authors(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- 11. CHAPTERS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE chapters (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    book_id UUID NOT NULL,

    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,

    chapter_number INTEGER NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT fk_chapters_book
        FOREIGN KEY (book_id)
        REFERENCES books(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT chapters_number_check
        CHECK (chapter_number > 0),

    CONSTRAINT unique_book_chapter_number
        UNIQUE (book_id, chapter_number)
);


-- ============================================================
-- 12. PAGES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE pages (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    chapter_id UUID NOT NULL,

    page_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(255),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT fk_pages_chapter
        FOREIGN KEY (chapter_id)
        REFERENCES chapters(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT pages_number_check
        CHECK (page_number > 0),

    CONSTRAINT unique_chapter_page_number
        UNIQUE (chapter_id, page_number)
);


-- ============================================================
-- 13. PAGE CONTENTS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE page_contents (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    page_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    content JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    text_alignment VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'left',
    font_family VARCHAR(100),
    font_size INTEGER,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT fk_page_contents_page
        FOREIGN KEY (page_id)
        REFERENCES pages(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- 14. MEDIA ASSETS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE media_assets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    storage_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    url TEXT,

    file_size BIGINT,
    mime_type VARCHAR(100),

    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT media_assets_type_check
        CHECK (
            type IN (
                'IMAGE',
                'AUDIO',
                'MODEL_3D',
                'VIDEO'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT media_assets_status_check
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'ACTIVE',
                'INACTIVE',
                'DELETED'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT media_assets_file_size_check
        CHECK (
            file_size IS NULL OR file_size >= 0
        )
);


-- ============================================================
-- 15. PAGE MEDIA
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE page_media (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    page_id UUID NOT NULL,
    media_asset_id UUID NOT NULL,

    display_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    position VARCHAR(50),
    caption TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT fk_page_media_page
        FOREIGN KEY (page_id)
        REFERENCES pages(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_page_media_asset
        FOREIGN KEY (media_asset_id)
        REFERENCES media_assets(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT page_media_order_check
        CHECK (display_order >= 0)
);


-- ============================================================
-- 16. MODEL 3D CONFIGS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE model_3d_configs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    media_asset_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    auto_rotate BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    rotation_speed NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,

    camera_distance NUMERIC(8,2),

    allow_zoom BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    allow_rotate BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    allow_pan BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT fk_model_3d_configs_asset
        FOREIGN KEY (media_asset_id)
        REFERENCES media_assets(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- 17. READING PROGRESS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE reading_progress (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    user_id UUID NOT NULL,
    book_id UUID NOT NULL,

    chapter_id UUID,
    page_id UUID,

    progress_percent NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    last_read_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT fk_reading_progress_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_reading_progress_book
        FOREIGN KEY (book_id)
        REFERENCES books(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_reading_progress_chapter
        FOREIGN KEY (chapter_id)
        REFERENCES chapters(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    CONSTRAINT fk_reading_progress_page
        FOREIGN KEY (page_id)
        REFERENCES pages(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    CONSTRAINT reading_progress_percent_check
        CHECK (
            progress_percent >= 0
            AND progress_percent <= 100
        ),

    CONSTRAINT unique_user_book_progress
        UNIQUE (user_id, book_id)
);


-- ============================================================
-- 18. READING HISTORY
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE reading_history (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    user_id UUID NOT NULL,
    book_id UUID NOT NULL,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    last_read_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    CONSTRAINT fk_reading_history_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_reading_history_book
        FOREIGN KEY (book_id)
        REFERENCES books(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- 19. FAVORITES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE favorites (
    user_id UUID NOT NULL,
    book_id UUID NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, book_id),

    CONSTRAINT fk_favorites_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT fk_favorites_book
        FOREIGN KEY (book_id)
        REFERENCES books(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================================
-- INDEXES
-- ============================================================

CREATE INDEX idx_user_profiles_user_id
    ON user_profiles(user_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_roles_role_id
    ON user_roles(role_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_refresh_tokens_user_id
    ON refresh_tokens(user_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_refresh_tokens_expires_at
    ON refresh_tokens(expires_at);

CREATE INDEX idx_books_status
    ON books(status);

CREATE INDEX idx_books_published_at
    ON books(published_at);

CREATE INDEX idx_books_total_views
    ON books(total_views);

CREATE INDEX idx_chapters_book_id
    ON chapters(book_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_pages_chapter_id
    ON pages(chapter_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_page_media_page_id
    ON page_media(page_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_page_media_asset_id
    ON page_media(media_asset_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_media_assets_type
    ON media_assets(type);

CREATE INDEX idx_reading_progress_user_id
    ON reading_progress(user_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_reading_history_user_id
    ON reading_history(user_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_reading_history_book_id
    ON reading_history(book_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_reading_history_last_read_at
    ON reading_history(last_read_at);

CREATE INDEX idx_favorites_book_id
    ON favorites(book_id);
